messages:
sam: Noticing a spike of SCIM deprovision failures for tenant `fathom-llc` starting 11:02 UTC. Errors show NameID mismatch during SAML logout mapping.

aya: paste from auth proxy: 
```
2026-03-26T11:02:13Z ERROR sso/saml.go:243 mapError: NameID format mismatch: expected urn:oasis:names:tc:SAML:1.1:nameid-format:emailAddress got urn:oasis:names:tc:SAML:2.0:nameid-format:persistent; user=joe@fathom.io req=ea12
```

leo: Did the SP metadata change on our side or did the IdP change their NameID profile?

sam: I checked onboarding logs — we updated SP descriptor for a new attribute remap earlier today (PR 5299). That PR changed nameid-format to email for new tenants, but looks like fathom-llc still sends persistent.

aya: Two paths: 1) update our mapping to accept both formats (email + persistent) and fallback to the NameID.value when format differs, 2) ask IdP to send email format. For immediate mitigation, accept persistent and try to resolve to an identity via external_id lookup.

sre-oncall: Can we make the change non-breaking? We should add tolerant parsing behind a feature flag and rollout to canary.

leo: I'll open a small hotfix to treat persistent NameID as valid if we can resolve it to an account via extID or email lookup. Will log which branch matched for audit.

sam: also seeing related SCIM audit entries show deprovision attempts without a matching RBAC history for that tenant. Might be a symptom: our deprovision job keyed off NameID email matching and failed to find user -> left dangling role entries.

audit-bot: automated note: recorded 47 failed deprovision events for tenant=fathom-llc between 2026-03-26T11:02:00Z and 2026-03-26T11:10:00Z. Linked incident id SEC-2026-051.

aya: mitigation plan: 1) deploy tolerant NameID parsing to canary (leo), 2) run a scoped backfill to reconcile dangling roles for the tenant (sam), 3) update onboarding docs to not change SP nameid-format without a compatibility window.

leo: deploying canary now. Will add metrics: nameid_format_mismatch_count and resolution_method tag.

deploy-bot: deploy started: infra/auth-proxy v2.3.8 (commit c9d0e1) - 2026-03-26T11:15:02Z

sre-oncall: suppression created for pager `scim.deprovision.errors` while canary runs. Keep audit trail in thread.

sam: backfill script run: `./tools/reconcile_roles --tenant fathom-llc --since 2026-03-26T10:50Z` — reconciled 32 dangling roles, no data loss.

aya: post-incident actions: add integration test that simulates IdP sending persistent NameID, add runbook step to notify SSO owners if SP metadata changes, and tag PRs that alter SAML descriptor with compatibility label.

sam: closing loop with CS and tenant ops. Will file a short postmortem and link runbook updates to SEC-2026-051. Thanks. :white_check_mark:
